sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.error: The sound clips could not be loaded.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: This removes the clip and its audio file for good.
delete.nothing: No command, pipeline or reward plays this clip.

dialog.newDescription: Upload an audio file. Set the chat word, cooldown and who may play it with Edit.
dialog.editDescription: The audio file and the short name stay as uploaded.
dialog.fileHelp: An audio file of at most 10 MB.
dialog.name: Short name
dialog.nameHelp: Commands and pipelines find the clip by this name. It cannot change later.
dialog.cooldownHelp: How long the clip waits before chat can play it again. 0 means no wait.
dialog.triggerHelp: A word with no spaces and no prefix. Chat plays the clip by typing it. Leave empty for none.

problem.volumeRange: The volume is a whole number from 0 to {max}.
problem.cooldownNegative: The cooldown is a whole number of seconds, 0 or more.
problem.triggerTooLong: The chat word may have at most {trigger} characters.
problem.triggerHasSpace: The chat word cannot contain spaces.
